semiconductor_relevance: High — DNJO Technologies specializes in the design, manufacturing, and cleaning of semiconductor-related carriers and equipment, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: DNJO Technologies Co., Ltd provides customized design, R&D, manufacturing, and cleaning services for semiconductor and optoelectronic carriers and equipment. The company emphasizes sustainability and cleanliness in its processes, offering high-cleanliness products and recycling services.
capabilities: Customized design and manufacturing of semiconductor carriers
Cleaning contract manufacturing for semiconductor equipment
Vehicle recycling and cleaning services for semiconductor packaging
